name: openeyes
description: OpenEyes — AI-friendly computer-use primitives (capture/detect/click) as a CLI and MCP server. Drives any desktop GUI on Windows/macOS/Linux via the platform accessibility tree, with Vimium-style grid fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Capture/detect/click + MCP server for AI desktop automation
interface.longDescription: OpenEyes provides primitives for AI agents to see and operate any desktop UI: capture screenshots, enumerate interactive elements via the platform accessibility tree (UIA on Windows, AX on macOS, AT-SPI on Linux), click by coordinates / text / handle / hint, snap to a Vimium-style grid, drag, type, send hotkeys. Pluggable vision backend (OmniParser/Florence) for legacy UIs. Safe-by-default: every click defaults to dry-run.
defaultPrompt: Use openeyes to find the message input box in the Feishu client and click it
Take a screenshot of the foreground window, enumerate its clickable elements, and click the one matching the user's intent
Drive an unknown legacy desktop app by enumerating its controls via UIAutomation
Open the Any VPN window and re-click the 'Secure my connection' button every 20s (dry-run by default)
